This is a report in the *quadrant* format: a Quarto book whose equations
link to the code that evaluates them, whose quantitative claims link to the
tests that pin them, and whose experiments open in a laboratory that runs in
the browser. Replace this page, the chapter, the core and the laboratory with
your own; keep the conventions (see the [status appendix](chapters/status.qmd)).
